references.label: WHO Classification of mast cell disorders 2022; EAACI anaphylaxis position paper

notes: Elevated in 50-75% of active sarcoidosis. Not diagnostic alone — used for monitoring activity. ACE inhibitor therapy suppresses levels.

references.label: ATS/ERS/WASOG sarcoidosis statement; Pagana Mosby Diagnostic Tests

notes: Aldosterone-to-renin ratio is the standard screening test for primary aldosteronism. ARR >30 (with aldosterone >15 ng/dL) is suggestive — confirm with saline infusion or fludrocortisone suppression.

references.label: Endocrine Society 2016 primary aldosteronism guideline (Funder et al., JCEM 2016)

notes: Withdraw spironolactone, eplerenone, amiloride ≥4 weeks before testing. Maintain potassium >4 mmol/L for accurate interpretation.

references.label: Endocrine Society 2016 primary aldosteronism guideline

notes: Age- and sex-dependent. Markedly elevated (>20 umol/L) suggests adrenal source of androgen excess (tumour or CAH). Adrenal origin (vs ovarian) in hirsute woman.

references.label: Endocrine Society 2018 hirsutism guideline

notes: Calculated free testosterone uses SHBG + albumin + total testosterone. Low SHBG: obesity, insulin resistance, hypothyroidism, androgens. High SHBG: hyperthyroidism, oestrogens, ageing, hepatic disease.

references.label: Endocrine Society 2018 testosterone deficiency guideline

notes: Ovarian reserve marker. Markedly low <1 pmol/L suggests diminished reserve / impending menopause; high >50 supports PCOS; very high possible granulosa cell tumour.

references.label: ESHRE 2023 PCOS evidence-based guideline; ASRM ovarian reserve testing

notes: Marker of medullary thyroid cancer. Basal >100 ng/L highly suspicious; pentagastrin/calcium stimulation test used in indeterminate cases. Smoking, PPIs, renal failure cause modest elevations.

references.label: ATA 2015 medullary thyroid cancer guideline (Wells et al., Thyroid 2015)

notes: (CSF IgG/serum IgG) / (CSF albumin/serum albumin). Elevated in MS, neurosarcoidosis, neuro-Behçet, autoimmune encephalitis. Oligoclonal bands (CSF without serum bands) more sensitive for MS.

references.label: McDonald 2017 criteria for MS diagnosis (Thompson et al., Lancet Neurol 2018)

notes: Spectrophotometric assay 12 h to 2 weeks after suspected SAH onset. Net bilirubin absorbance >0.007 AU positive. Protect sample from light, deliver promptly.

references.label: UK National External Quality Assessment Service (NEQAS) guidance; ABN guidance on SAH

notes: SAAG = serum albumin − ascitic albumin. ≥11 g/L (or ≥1.1 g/dL): portal hypertension (cirrhosis, HF, Budd-Chiari). <11 g/L: non-portal-hypertensive causes (peritoneal carcinomatosis, TB, pancreatitis).

references.label: AASLD 2021 ascites guidelines; EASL 2018 decompensated cirrhosis

analyte: Ascitic fluid neutrophil count — SBP threshold
notes: ≥250 polymorphonuclear cells/mm³ in ascitic fluid is diagnostic of spontaneous bacterial peritonitis — start empiric antibiotics immediately and add IV albumin.

references.label: AASLD 2021 ascites guidelines; EASL 2018 decompensated cirrhosis

notes: Exudate if any of: pleural LDH > 2/3 of serum ULN; pleural:serum LDH > 0.6; pleural:serum protein > 0.5.

references.label: BTS 2010 pleural disease guideline; Light et al., Ann Intern Med 1972

analyte: Pleural fluid pH — complicated parapneumonic threshold
notes: pH <7.20 in parapneumonic effusion indicates drainage. Measure on heparinised blood-gas syringe within 1 h. Glucose <2.2 mmol/L and LDH >1000 are additional drainage criteria.

references.label: BTS 2010 pleural disease guideline

analyte: Synovial fluid WBC — septic arthritis threshold
notes: Native joint: >50 × 10⁹/L with >75% neutrophils suggests septic arthritis (but no value reliably excludes — treat empirically if clinical suspicion). Prosthetic joint: >3.0 × 10⁹/L threshold (MSIS criteria).

references.label: BSR/BHPR 2017 hot swollen joint guideline; MSIS 2018 PJI criteria

notes: <50 normal; 50-250 borderline (repeat); >250 active IBD likely. Used to distinguish IBD from IBS and monitor IBD activity (mucosal healing).

references.label: NICE DG11 faecal calprotectin; BSG 2019 IBD guidelines

notes: >200 normal; 100-200 mild-moderate exocrine pancreatic insufficiency; <100 severe insufficiency. Not affected by pancreatic enzyme replacement.

references.label: BSG 2018 chronic pancreatitis guidelines; UEG/EPC EPI guidelines 2017

notes: CSF lactate >3.5 mmol/L strongly supports bacterial meningitis (sensitivity ~93%, specificity ~96%) even after partial antibiotic treatment. Less reliable in post-neurosurgical patients.

references.label: Sakushima et al., J Infect 2011 (meta-analysis of CSF lactate); IDSA bacterial meningitis guidelines (Tunkel et al., CID 2004)
